❓ Frequently asked questions

How are US hat sizes calculated?

US (and UK) hat sizes equal the head circumference in inches divided by π, rounded to the nearest eighth — e.g. a 22-inch head ÷ π ≈ 7.

Are EU hat sizes just centimetres?

Yes — EU and Japanese sizes are simply the head circumference in centimetres, rounded to the nearest whole cm.

How do I measure my head?

Measure around your head just above the eyebrows and ears, where the hat will sit. Use a soft tape, snug but not tight.
